name: Haijima Mitsuki
source: One of the characters of the Matchmaker story. A mysterious man with a penchant for theatrics. [spoiler]An affiliate of the neo-Okiai syndicate's Shigino wing. Runs KamuiNet25 as "Translator", writes for the 25-Today newspaper under the pen name "Hatsuo Mikijima".[/spoiler]
